title: Quarterly Shift Plan for the Eastside Clinic

headings.text: Quarterly Shift Plan for the Eastside Clinic

key_sentences: The clinic runs two shifts on most weekdays.
Teams rotate every quarter to share the evening work.
Each team leader confirms the rota by the last Friday of the month.
Swaps between teams must be approved by the duty manager.
The clinic is closed on Wednesdays while the staff training programme runs.
Room 3 is reserved for vaccinations on Thursdays.

tables.caption: Table 1. Teams on duty by day and shift

notes: Full-width title, then a two-column grid. Left column: 'Rota' heading, a paragraph, then the table (full borders). Right column: 'Notes for Staff' heading and two paragraphs, set beside the table. Reading order is the whole left column, then the right column; right-column text must not be interleaved with table rows. Merges: 'Monday', 'Tuesday', 'Thursday' each span 2 rows (rowspan); 'Room 3' spans 2 rows; 'Closed for staff training' spans 3 columns (colspan, centred, italic). In the expected grid a merged cell repeats its text in every cell it covers; grid is 8 rows x 4 columns, header first. Font Arial.
